description.narrative: Nordic-Indian Dialogue (NID) with participation from the research community, business and academia. Conference on potential areas of cooperation, such as renewable energy and climate mitigation, against a backdrop of geopolitical changes, and where trust-based partnerships with large countries such as India are crucial to achieving the UN's sustainability goal 17, etc., climate goals and other global objectives.
